issues.description: Input closure remains incomplete because the package supplies code and an identifier list but omits many required prepared panels and author-coded inputs. Readable TASS company-details/service-provider fields and native Fama-French monthly factors are positively established as components. The richer prepared product-performance contract, manual crosswalks/disclosures, CRSP excess-return panels, Hsieh/unsmoothed panels and several auxiliary/text-characteristic producers remain specifically unverified or unprovided.

The raw entry writes five named panels under its Data directory, while the main entry reads the same five basenames without a Data prefix. The supplied raw-stage saves and main-stage readers establish a same-data directory-alignment task; a portable working-copy layout needs no historical absolute root values. No different source population, missing output field, or scientific identity contradiction is established by the admitted evidence.

The Q11 files are merged by organizationcrd/year and downstream code uses Q11/materiality flags, but the supplied source does not allocate each payload field to its individual CSV. The risk-mention and additional characteristic tables also have incomplete file-specific payload mapping.

The raw script merges four Data\chara_misreporting files by productreference but contains no producer for them. The main analysis expects pct_finterms negative, positive, uncertainty, constraining, litigious and modal feature columns from test1_new1; the source does not map those fields to the four individual inputs.

The author-prepared product-performance tables carry a much richer contract than the six-variable catalogued TASS.PRODUCTPERFORMANCE table. The supplied programs do not show how those author tables are assembled from the available TASS components, and the bounded full-field request is unverified; no absent-data or license conclusion is drawn.

The raw program builds and saves a product-level merge2_finalresult object containing keys used by later finalresult consumers, then reads that object into the monthly branch and clears memory with main_step0 before the later consumers. The distinct finalresult path is a supported conditional same-object setup handoff at the actual writer's lifecycle point, not a separately missing author data product; preserve future ID/population checks.

actions.description: Stage the exact author-prepared input tables or their documented compatible source routes, then reconcile their native columns, join keys, periods, units and selection against both scripts.
steps: Obtain or locate only the named author-prepared TASS, factor, SEC, manually coded disclosure, auxiliary and survival inputs listed in requirements; do not rebuild manual judgments from public sources.
For every input, verify the exact source table, required native fields, identifier format, units, date coverage, key uniqueness and the transformation into the source-relative file used by Stata.

For the four Q11 files, record which file supplies each Q11/materiality variable; for the four chara_misreporting files, identify each producer and map the pct_finterms output columns to the file that supplies them.
Keep the TASS company/service and Fama-French probes as component evidence only; do not treat them as proof of the richer prepared performance, CRSP excess-return or Hsieh files.
validation: Confirm each named source-relative file resolves to a documented candidate route and has all consumed native fields before any authorized future execution.
Confirm monthly/annual date coverage and entity keys for the requested 2012–2019 branches; one-row probes do not establish history or population.

actions.description: Configure a portable same-data directory handoff so the five raw-stage generated panels resolve to the exact five basenames read by the main stage.
steps: In a working-copy run layout, choose a stage root that contains a Data directory; configure the raw entry's relative Data outputs to write within that staged Data directory.
Configure the main entry's input working directory or explicit data base so each bare reader resolves to that same staged Data file; do not rely on the historical private root values.

Keep the generated panels from the raw entry as the main entry's inputs. If the chosen layout stages copies, document that they are the same generated panels and preserve their identifiers and columns.
validation: For each of maintest_full_2022, quarterly flow_full_2022, test1_new1_2022, maintest_2022_full and maintest2_full, resolve the raw save target and main reader to one staged file before starting the main entry.
Check each generated file's main-consumed columns, join keys and identifier/population continuity against the supplied source contracts before the later analysis branch uses it.

actions.description: Propose a separate save of the source-built merge2_finalresult object under the path consumed later as finalresult, without changing the existing merge2 output or the intervening monthly panel branch.

edits.reason: The preceding source-built product-level object retains productreference, organizationcrd and companyid. The later finalresult consumers use those keys only. Saving a second path at this exact point preserves the original merge2 result and avoids relying on the intervening main_step0 in-memory panel; the data IDs and row population still need future validation.

steps: Apply the proposed second save only in a working copy after confirming the required input population has been built by the existing preceding code.
Keep the existing merge2_finalresult save unchanged and write the same in-memory product-level object to Data\finalresult 9.24.dta before the RIA import and monthly return merge.
validation: Compare the row count and sorted productreference/organizationcrd/companyid keys in both saved paths in a later authorized data-validation step.
Confirm the finalresult consumers' required identifier set and uniqueness before using the alias for auditor, disclosure, auxiliary and characteristic merges.

actions.description: Prepare the two Stata command dependencies whose exact environment probes show a missing command or configured-only lookup.
steps: Install or stage a compatible matchit ado package using its documented source and record the resolved command/version; do not run the author program during setup.
Configure the existing xtfmb ado lookup path in the Stata environment and record that the source command resolves under the intended run configuration.
validation: Use a non-author-code command-availability check after setup to confirm matchit and xtfmb resolve and record their versions/configuration.

actions.description: Conditional future run procedure for LMZ 2025 Code_raw file.do followed by LMZ 2025 Code_main.do after all named inputs and exact software setup are resolved.
steps: Stage and verify the required raw/prepared input tables and manually coded products, then resolve the two software setup actions before either author entry program is started.
Use a portable working-copy root with a Data directory and configure the raw relative outputs and main bare-name readers to resolve to the same five generated panels.

Run the raw entry through its supplied source order and branches. At the source-built merge2_finalresult writer after line 661, apply only the conditional second save proposed by ACT_FINALRESULT_ALIAS; retain the original merge2 save and the monthly branch order, and compare IDs/population before later consumers.
Complete the raw stage and confirm all five named generated panels are present with the expected fields and keys before starting the main entry.
Then run the original main entry branches as supplied and check their declared table/figure outputs and source-defined panel usage; do not substitute a reconstructed analysis path.
validation: Record resolved raw save/main reader file pairs for all five panels and verify that every pair refers to the same staged product before the main entry begins.
Confirm required input and panel schemas, identifiers and branch populations; retain the source-supported merge2/finalresult key comparison for the later alias consumers.
Verify the original main branches reach their declared output destinations and preserve the expected produced tables and figures for review.

review_notes: Both supplied Stata sources were read in full through the saved byte-first reader; one-based physical source rows are cited. Raw logs were not displayed. The five raw save names and main read basenames match; a portable same-data directory layout is a preparation step and does not depend on historical private root values.

All 108 frozen dependency IDs are covered. Source I/O closure also includes the additional merge/append/join inputs; every generated review cites its direct source save and consumers. Catalogue discovery is not treated as live compatible data proof.
The packaged identifier.dta is a one-row identifier-list probe only; it is not used as a full analysis input. The work item lists no related packages.

Company-details and service-provider TASS candidates, plus FF.FACTORS_MONTHLY, had bounded one-row readable-field probes; their historical or full-sample coverage is not verified. The full TASS product-performance contract and author-derived CRSP/Hsieh/unsmoothed panels remain unverified.

The finalresult path is treated as a source-supported same-object setup handoff at the actual merge2 writer; a conditional second save preserves the existing output and future identifier/population checks remain required.
No author program, SAS startup, statistical model, dataset download, package installation, source-data mutation, external message or applied patch was performed.

A conditional run_procedure action sequences verified input/software preparation, portable raw/main directory alignment, the source-ordered raw branches and same-object alias, five generated panels, and the original main analysis/output checks; no author program or model was run during this assessment.
